name: example-promax-health-dashboard
title: Healthcare Analytics Dashboard
description: Clean clinical operations dashboard: fixed sidebar navigation, KPI stat cards with trend deltas, admissions line chart plus department donut chart (inline SVG), recent-patients table with status pills, and a same-day schedule column. Light slate surface with a clinical blue primary and Fira Sans/Fira Code type. Use when the brief mentions "dashboard", "admin panel", "analytics", "hospital metrics", "operations overview".

query.en: Build a hospital operations dashboard with KPI cards, an admissions trend chart, a department donut chart, a recent-patients table, and today's schedule.
